schema.text: When you use public transport, what makes you feel anxious or overwhelmed?

ar.#Aggressive or careless drivers, riders: سائقون أو راكبو دراجات أو مشاة عدوانيون أو غير منتبهين
ar.#Feeling alone or isolated on the way: الشعور بالوحدة أو العزلة في الطريق
ar.#Health problems on the way (pain, breat: مشكلات صحية في الطريق (ألم، ضيق نفس، دوخة)
ar.#Noise, crowds or too much going on arou: ضجيج أو زحام أو أشياء كثيرة جدًا حولي
ar.#Not knowing when the bus, tram or train: عدم معرفة موعد وصول الحافلة أو الترام أو القطار
ar.#Routes that are complicated or new to m: طرق معقّدة أو غير مألوفة بالنسبة إليّ
ar.#When you use public transport, what mak: عند استخدام وسائل النقل العام، ما الذي يجعلك تشعر بالقلق أو بالإرهاق الشديد؟

fa.#Aggressive or careless drivers, riders: رانندگان، موتورسواران و دوچرخه‌سواران یا عابران پیادهٔ پرخاشگر یا بی‌احتیاط
fa.#Being in a hurry or afraid of being lat: عجله داشتن یا ترس از دیر رسیدن
fa.#Feeling alone or isolated on the way: احساس تنهایی یا انزوا در مسیر
fa.#Health problems on the way (pain, breat: مشکلات سلامتی در مسیر (درد، تنگی نفس، سرگیجه)
fa.#Noise, crowds or too much going on arou: سر و صدا، شلوغی یا هیاهوی زیاد در اطراف
fa.#Not knowing when the bus, tram or train: ندانستن اینکه اتوبوس، تراموا یا قطار کی می‌رسد

fa.#When you use public transport, what mak: هنگام استفاده از حمل‌ونقل عمومی، چه چیزی باعث نگرانی یا احساس فشار زیاد در شما می‌شود؟

fr.#Aggressive or careless drivers, riders: Conducteurs, cyclistes ou piétons agressifs ou imprudents
fr.#Being in a hurry or afraid of being lat: Être pressé ou avoir peur d'être en retard
fr.#Fear of road accidents: Peur des accidents de la route
fr.#Feeling alone or isolated on the way: Me sentir seul ou isolé en chemin
fr.#Health problems on the way (pain, breat: Problèmes de santé en chemin (douleur, essoufflement, vertiges)
fr.#Noise, crowds or too much going on arou: Du bruit, de la foule ou trop d'agitation autour de moi
fr.#Not knowing when the bus, tram or train: Ne pas savoir quand le bus, le tram ou le train arrivera
fr.#Routes that are complicated or new to m: Des itinéraires compliqués ou nouveaux pour moi
fr.#When you use public transport, what mak: Lorsque vous utilisez les transports en commun, qu’est-ce qui vous cause de l’anxiété ou un sentiment de débordement ?

hu.#Aggressive or careless drivers, riders: Agresszív vagy figyelmetlen járművezetők, kerékpárosok, motorosok vagy gyalogosok

hu.#Health problems on the way (pain, breat: Egészségügyi problémák az úton (fájdalom, légszomj, szédülés)
hu.#Noise, crowds or too much going on arou: Zaj, tömeg vagy túl sok minden történik körülöttem
hu.#Not knowing when the bus, tram or train: Nem tudni, mikor érkezik a busz, a villamos vagy a vonat
hu.#When you use public transport, what mak: Tömegközlekedés közben mi miatt érzi magát szorongónak vagy túlterheltnek?

it.#Aggressive or careless drivers, riders: Automobilisti, conducenti di altri mezzi o pedoni aggressivi o distratti

it.#Feeling alone or isolated on the way: Sentirmi solo o isolato lungo la strada
it.#Health problems on the way (pain, breat: Problemi di salute lungo la strada (dolore, fiato corto, vertigini)
it.#Noise, crowds or too much going on arou: Rumore, folla o troppa confusione intorno a me
it.#Not knowing when the bus, tram or train: Non sapere quando arriverà l’autobus, il tram o il treno

tr.#Aggressive or careless drivers, riders: Agresif veya dikkatsiz sürücüler, bisikletliler ya da yayalar

tr.#Feeling alone or isolated on the way: Yolda kendimi yalnız veya tecrit edilmiş hissetmek
tr.#Health problems on the way (pain, breat: Yolda sağlık sorunları (ağrı, nefes darlığı, baş dönmesi)
tr.#Noise, crowds or too much going on arou: Gürültü, kalabalık veya etrafımda çok fazla hareketlilik
tr.#Not knowing when the bus, tram or train: Otobüsün, tramvayın veya trenin ne zaman geleceğini bilmemek
tr.#Routes that are complicated or new to m: Karmaşık veya benim için yeni güzergâhlar
tr.#When you use public transport, what mak: Toplu taşıma kullanırken sizi kaygılı veya bunalmış hissettiren nedir?
